summary:
- Scope and purpose: EU Taxonomy KPIs for insurance and reinsurance investments (Annex X) with standard Article 8 templates (Annex XII), excluding sovereign exposures; focus on Taxonomy eligibility/alignment, counterparty breakdowns, and nuclear/fossil gas-related activities.

- Asset base and coverage:
  - Assets covered by KPI: 161,929 NOK million; coverage ratio 89.4% of total investments (ex-sovereigns).
  - Derivatives: (2,431) NOK million, representing (1.5)% of assets covered.

- Taxonomy eligibility and alignment (overall):
  - Non-eligible investments: 136,923 NOK million (84.6% of assets covered).
  - Eligible but not aligned: 18,872 NOK million (11.7%).
  - Taxonomy-aligned (weighted average of investments): 5,202 NOK million (turnover-based) and 4,738 NOK million (capex-based), equal to 3.2% and 2.9% of assets covered.
  - Investments (ex unit-linked) that are aligned: 2,022 NOK million (turnover-based) and 1,795 NOK million (capex-based); equals 1.2% and 1.1% of assets covered.

- Environmental objective split (aligned):
  - Climate change mitigation: 3.1% (turnover), 2.7% (capex), incl. transitional 0.3% and enabling 0.9–1.0%.
  - All other objectives (adaptation, water, circular economy, pollution, biodiversity): 0%.

- Counterparty and geography breakdown (amounts and proportions over assets covered):
  - Exposures subject to Articles 19a/29a (EU):
    - Non-financial: 7,643 NOK million; 4.7% of assets.
    - Financial: 40,881 NOK million; 25.2% of assets.
  - Exposures not subject to 19a/29a:
    - Non-financial: 34 NOK million; 0%.
    - Financial: 15,335 NOK million; 9.5%.
  - Non-EU not subject to 19a/29a:
    - Non-financial: 1,962 NOK million; 1.2%.
    - Financial: 17,155 NOK million; 10.6%.
  - Other counterparties and assets: 81,349 NOK million; 50.2%.

- Aligned exposure details:
  - To undertakings subject to 19a/29a:
    - Non-financial: 1,031 NOK million (turnover), 1,345 NOK million (capex) → 0.6% and 0.8% of assets.
    - Financial: 194 NOK million (turnover), 765 NOK million (capex) → 0.7% and 0.5%.
  - To other counterparties/assets: 2,977 NOK million (turnover), 2,627 NOK million (capex) → 1.8% and 1.6%.

- Unit-linked exclusion: Separate reporting for investments other than those where life insurance policyholders bear investment risk.

- Nuclear and fossil gas-related activities (Template 1): The undertaking has exposures to all listed nuclear activities (R&D, new build, operation/safety upgrades) and fossil gaseous fuel activities (power generation, CHP, and heat generation) — all marked YES.

- Article 8 standard templates (Templates 2–3, Total GAR assets, stock – Turnover):
  - Denominator (aligned activities): Total 144,246 NOK million (5.16%); includes 43 NOK million under Section 4.28 and remainder under “other taxonomy-aligned activities.”
  - Numerator (aligned activities): Total 144,246 NOK million (100% of numerator); includes 41 NOK million under Section 4.28 and remainder under “other taxonomy-aligned activities.”

start_phrase: 1.The undertaking carries out, funds or has exposures to research, development, demonstration and deployment of innovative electricity generation facilities that produce energy from nuclear processes with minimal waste from the fuel cycle.YES
summary:
- Scope and context: Extract from DNB Group Annual Report 2024 (Sustainability report – EU Taxonomy, Annex XII templates under Article 8(6) and (7)), presented on a “Total GAR assets, stock – Turnover” basis, with amounts in NOK million and split across climate objectives (CCM+CCA, CCM, CCA).

- Template 1 – Nuclear and fossil gas related activities: The undertaking confirms “YES” exposures/activities across:
  - R&D, demonstration and deployment of innovative nuclear electricity generation with minimal fuel-cycle waste.
  - Construction and safe operation of new nuclear installations (including district heating/industrial uses such as hydrogen) and safety upgrades.
  - Safe operation of existing nuclear installations (including district heating/industrial hydrogen) and safety upgrades.
  - Construction/operation of electricity generation using fossil gaseous fuels.
  - Construction, refurbishment, and operation of combined heat/cool and power using fossil gaseous fuels.
  - Construction, refurbishment, and operation of heat generation using fossil gaseous fuels.

- Template 2 – Taxonomy-aligned economic activities (denominator):
  - Breakdown by Delegated Regulation 2021/2139 Sections 4.26–4.31 shows mostly zero amounts; Section 4.28 records NOK 43 (with 0.00% share shown in the template’s percentage columns).
  - “Other taxonomy-aligned economic activities” account for the bulk: NOK ~144,203 (CCM+CCA), with NOK ~144,199 in CCM and ~NOK 3 in CCA.
  - Total applicable KPI denominator: NOK ~144,246, representing 5.16%.

- Template 3 – Taxonomy-aligned economic activities (numerator):
  - Small amounts in specific sections: NOK 1 (Section 4.27) and NOK 41 (Section 4.28); all others zero.
  - “Other taxonomy-aligned economic activities” comprise virtually all of the numerator: NOK ~144,204 (99.97%).
  - Total numerator equals NOK ~144,246 and, by definition within the template, represents 100.00% of the applicable KPI numerator.
  - Climate split indicates near-total allocation to mitigation (CCM), with adaptation (CCA) amounts negligible (~NOK 3).

start_phrase: 1.The undertaking carries out, funds or has exposures to research, development, demonstration and deployment of innovative electricity generation facilities that produce energy from nuclear processes with minimal waste from the fuel cycle.YES
summary:
This excerpt from DNB Group’s 2024 Annual Report (EU Taxonomy section) presents Green Asset Ratio (GAR) disclosures for capex, structured in three templates:

- Template 1 confirms the undertaking carries out, funds, or has exposures to all listed nuclear and fossil gas-related activities: nuclear R&D and deployment; construction and safe operation of new and existing nuclear installations (including safety upgrades and industrial heat/hydrogen uses); and construction/refurbishment/operation of electricity, CHP, and heat generation facilities using fossil gaseous fuels. All six categories are marked “YES.”

- Template 2 (denominator) and Template 3 (numerator) report amounts and proportions of taxonomy-aligned economic activities under Delegated Regulation 2021/2139 (Sections 4.26–4.31, covering nuclear and fossil gas activities) and “other taxonomy-aligned activities,” in NOK million and percentages, mapped to climate objectives (CCM, CCA, or both).
  - Nuclear/gas sections show negligible amounts: Section 4.27 is NOK 29m in the denominator (NOK 23m in the numerator), Section 4.28 is NOK 13m in both; Sections 4.26 and 4.29–4.31 are NOK 0.
  - “Other taxonomy-aligned economic activities” dominate: NOK 144,536m in both denominator and numerator.
  - Totals: NOK 144,577m taxonomy-aligned capex included in the KPI. In the denominator this equals 5.17% of total applicable GAR assets; in the numerator, composition is 99.98% “other taxonomy-aligned,” with nuclear/gas shares rounding to 0.00–0.02%.

Overall, the disclosure indicates the bank has exposures to nuclear and fossil gas activities but the taxonomy-aligned capex captured in the KPI is overwhelmingly in other taxonomy-aligned activities, with nuclear/gas contributions immaterial in percentage terms.

summary:
- Section of DNB Group’s 2024 Annual Report (Sustainability report, EU Taxonomy) disclosing financial guarantees related to nuclear and fossil gas activities.
- Uses “Template 1: Nuclear and fossil gas related activities – Financial guarantees” to report exposures.
- Six assessed categories:
  1) R&D, demonstration and deployment of innovative nuclear electricity generation.
  2) Construction and safe operation of new nuclear installations (including safety upgrades and industrial uses like hydrogen).
  3) Safe operation of existing nuclear installations (including upgrades and industrial uses).
  4) Construction or operation of electricity generation using fossil gaseous fuels.
  5) Construction, refurbishment, and operation of combined heat/cool and power using fossil gaseous fuels.
  6) Construction, refurbishment, and operation of heat/cool generation using fossil gaseous fuels.
- For all six categories, the undertaking reports “NO” (no carrying out, funding, or exposures) under financial guarantees.
- Indicates DNB Group has no financial guarantee involvement in the listed nuclear or fossil gas activities for the reporting period.

summary:
- The section presents EU Taxonomy disclosures for DNB Group’s Assets under Management (AUM) using turnover-based KPIs, split into climate change mitigation (CCM), climate change adaptation (CCA), and combined (CCM+CCA).
- Template 4 (taxonomy-eligible but not taxonomy-aligned):
  - Minimal exposures under specific Sections 4.26–4.31 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2139: NOK 2m (Sec. 4.28), NOK 102m (Sec. 4.29), NOK 30m (Sec. 4.30), NOK 1m (Sec. 4.31); each ~0.00–0.01%.
  - “Other” eligible but not aligned activities: NOK 47,991m (6.48%) total; CCM NOK 37,566m (5.07%); CCA NOK 10,425m (1.41%).
  - Total eligible but not aligned: NOK 48,127m (6.50%); CCM NOK 37,702m (5.09%); CCA NOK 10,425m (1.41%).
- Template 5 (taxonomy-non-eligible):
  - Negligible amounts associated with specific sections (NOK 26m and NOK 1m); others zero.
  - “Other” non-eligible activities: NOK 676,349m (91.33%).
  - Total non-eligible: NOK 676,376m (91.33%).
- Key takeaway: The overwhelming share of AUM exposure by turnover is taxonomy non-eligible (91.33%), with a smaller share taxonomy-eligible but not aligned (6.50%), and only negligible amounts in the specifically cited regulatory sections.

summary:
- The fragment presents EU Taxonomy disclosures for DNB Group’s Assets under Management (AUM) – Turnover KPI, focusing on two templates: taxonomy-eligible but not taxonomy-aligned activities (Template 4) and taxonomy non-eligible activities (Template 5).
- Data are shown in NOK million and percentages, split across total (CCM + CCA), climate change mitigation (CCM), and climate change adaptation (CCA), and refer to the denominator of the applicable KPI.
- Template 4 details taxonomy-eligible but not aligned activities by specific sections of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2139 (Annexes I and II, Sections 4.26–4.31), with negligible amounts in these specific sections (mostly 0–102 NOK million).
- The bulk of eligible but not aligned exposure sits in “other” activities (row 7): 47,991 NOK million (6.48%) total, of which 37,566 NOK million (5.07%) is CCM and 10,425 NOK million (1.41%) is CCA.
- Total taxonomy-eligible but not aligned amounts (row 8) are 48,127 NOK million (6.50%) overall, split as 37,702 NOK million (5.09%) CCM and 10,425 NOK million (1.41%) CCA.
- Template 5 shows taxonomy non-eligible activities, with minimal amounts attributed to specific sections (26 and 1 NOK million), and the vast majority classified as “other” non-eligible (row 7): 676,349 NOK million (91.33%).
- Total non-eligible activities (row 8) are 676,376 NOK million (91.33%).
- The excerpt is part of the DNB Group Annual Report 2024 Sustainability Report, The EU Taxonomy section, and includes duplicated table content due to formatting.

summary:
This excerpt from DNB Group’s 2024 Annual Report (EU Taxonomy section) presents Assets under Management (AUM) Capex disclosures across three templates:

- Template 1 (Nuclear and fossil gas activities): The undertaking confirms it carries out, funds, or has exposures to all listed nuclear and fossil gas-related activities—nuclear R&D/innovation, construction and operation of new and existing nuclear installations (including safety upgrades), and construction/operation of electricity, CHP, and heat generation using fossil gaseous fuels (all marked YES).

- Template 2 (Denominator of KPI – taxonomy-aligned activities): Provides a breakdown of amounts and proportions (NOK million and %) of taxonomy-aligned economic activities by sections 4.26–4.31 of Delegated Regulation 2021/2139 and “other” activities, for climate change mitigation (CCM) and adaptation (CCA). Key figures:
  - Total applicable KPI: NOK 19,527 million, equal to 2.64% overall (2.62% CCM; 0.02% CCA).
  - Minimal amounts in specified sections: 4.26 = 0; 4.27 = NOK 53m; 4.28 = NOK 40m; 4.29 = NOK 2m; 4.30 = NOK 3m; 4.31 = 0.
  - Majority classified as “other taxonomy-aligned activities”: NOK 19,429m (2.62%).

- Template 3 (Numerator of KPI – taxonomy-aligned activities): Shows the aligned share within the denominator by the same sections and objectives.
  - Total taxonomy-aligned (numerator): NOK 19,527m (100.00% CCM+CCA), split 99.38% CCM (NOK 19,407m) and 0.62% CCA (NOK 121m).
  - Small allocations to sections 4.27–4.30 (53m, 35m, 2m, 3m respectively); none in 4.26 and 4.31.
  - The bulk remains in “other taxonomy-aligned activities”: NOK 19,435m (99.53%).

Overall, the disclosure confirms exposure to nuclear and fossil gas activities while quantifying that almost all taxonomy-aligned AUM Capex sits within “other taxonomy-aligned activities,” with nuclear/gas-specific sections representing a very small fraction.

Most of the denominator sits in “other taxonomy-aligned activities” (row 7: 4,412 NOKm; 2.72%). Sections 4.27 and 4.28 show small amounts (2 NOKm and 23 NOKm, each ~0.00–0.01%), while Sections 4.26 and 4.29–4.31 are 0. Data are split by climate objectives, with amounts primarily under climate change mitigation (CCM) and combined CCM+CCA; climate change adaptation (CCA) is negligible (about 1 NOKm; 0.00%).

- Taxonomy-aligned Capex – numerator (Template 3, NOK million): The numerator equals the denominator at 4,437 NOKm (100% of the applicable KPI). It is dominated by “other taxonomy-aligned activities” (4,427 NOKm; ~99.78%), with small contributions from Sections 4.27 (2 NOKm; 0.04%) and 4.28 (8 NOKm; 0.18%); Sections 4.26 and 4.29–4.31 are 0. Alignment is almost entirely within CCM/CCM+CCA, with minimal CCA (about 1 NOKm; ~0.02%).

Overall, within the portion of Capex deemed applicable to the KPI (2.74% of total), 100% is taxonomy-aligned, and the disclosure confirms broad exposure to nuclear and fossil gas related activities, while the quantified aligned amounts are concentrated in “other taxonomy-aligned activities” rather than the specified nuclear/gas sections.
